title: 第13章 外挂不应该这样啊第14章 第二张符
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
“单臂臂力72公斤。”
“40米折返跑9.9秒。”
“10公里跑32分钟。”
“……”
和平饭店安全部副部长李强同志，在自己的书写板夹上记录着，最后签上了自己的名字，然后递给苏醒。
“给，确认一下数据，没问题就在下面签上你的名字。
从现在开始的三十天内，你随时可以来找我重新测试。”
李强顿了顿，补充了一句，“提醒一下，你越早来复测，数据提升越明显，在老板那儿能拿到的好处可能就越多。”
苏醒胸口剧烈起伏，大口喘着粗气，连抬手都觉得费劲，只是艰难地点了点头，示意自己听到了。
看见苏醒这副近乎虚脱的模样，李强眉毛一挑，问道：
“是不是很累，要不要药。
活力药剂，25金币一管，喝下去疲劳全消，不耽误你接下来的训练，你要知道，你现在时间很宝贵。”
苏醒有气无力地摆了摆手，然后挣扎着从自己带来的背包里摸索出一管淡蓝色的药剂，拔掉塞子，仰头一饮而尽。
一股清凉舒爽的感觉迅速从胃部扩散至全身，肌肉的酸胀感和精神的疲惫正如潮水般退去。
看见苏醒居然自备了药剂，李强脸上闪过一丝悻悻之色，但显然不打算放弃，话锋一转又道：
“行啊，自己备了药，看来是有备而来。
不过我这儿还有别的硬通货，考虑到你正在接受老板的测试，有些猛药我也不好推荐。
但这个，绝对是必需品！”
说着，他又变魔术般从身后拿出一个装着琥珀色液体的小瓶子，容量大约300毫升。
“高纯度能量营养饮料，绝对零副作用，一金币两瓶。

最好是配合正餐使用，能极速补充高强度训练后身体损耗的各种微量元素和能量。”
“不是我吓唬你，就接下来你这训练强度，光靠食堂里那点普通伙食，身体根本扛不住。”
李强目光热切地看着苏醒，那眼神像极了推销保健品的私教。
苏醒喘匀了气，无语地看着他，忍不住开口吐槽：“李部长，你这饮料…它科技吗？”
“科技！
当然科技！”
李强把胸脯拍得砰砰响，“百分百的硬核科技与狠活，嘎嘎纯的科技精华，效果杠杠的！”
“那不了，不了，”
苏醒连连摆手，“我对科技过敏，喝了怕起疹子。”
“……”
李强一时语塞，脸上的表情十分精彩。
最终，苏醒还是掏钱买了一打（12瓶）所谓的“高纯度能量营养饮料”
毕竟李强有句话没说错，接下来的训练消耗肯定巨大，试试效果也无妨。
苏醒也知道李强这小子起码加了他三成价，但是算了，自己前途远大，何必在意这一点半点的。
苏醒好不容易摆脱了意犹未尽、还想继续推销其他产品的李副部长。
快步走进了一间空置的单人训练室，顺手关紧了门。
训练室内部陈设简单，但空间极为宽敞，长约十二米，宽约八米，显得十分空旷。
室内没有窗户，异常安静，只有仔细倾听，才能隐约听到头顶通风扇送气的微弱嗡鸣。
其中一整面墙都被改造成了武器架，上面挂满了各式兵器：
content_en:
"The arm strength of one arm is 72 kilograms."
"40-meter return run in 9.9 seconds."
"10 kilometers running in 32 minutes."
"..."
Comrade Li Qiang, deputy director of the Security Department of the Peace Hotel, recorded on his writing pad, signed his name, and handed it to Su Xing.
"Here, confirm the data. If it's ok, sign your name below.
You can come to me for retesting anytime within thirty days from now. "
Li Qiang paused and added, "Just a reminder, the earlier you come to retest, the more obvious the data improvement will be, and the more benefits you may get from the boss."
Su Xing's chest rose and fell violently, and he was breathing heavily. It was difficult to even raise his hands, so he just nodded with difficulty to indicate that he heard.
Seeing Su Xing's almost exhausted look, Li Qiang raised his eyebrows and asked:
"Are you tired? Do you want some medicine?
Vitality potion, 25 gold coins per tube. Drink it and your fatigue will disappear. It will not delay your next training. You must know that your time is precious now. "
Su Xing weakly waved his hand, then struggled to find a tube of light blue potion from the backpack he brought, pulled out the stopper, and drank it in one gulp.
A cool and refreshing feeling quickly spread from the stomach to the whole body, and the soreness of the muscles and mental fatigue receded like the tide.
Seeing that Su Xing had prepared his own potion, Li Qiang had a look of resentment on his face, but he obviously didn't intend to give up. He changed the subject and said:
“Okay, I prepared the medicine myself, it seems that I came prepared.
But I have other hard currency here. Considering that you are being tested by your boss, there are some strong medicines that I can’t recommend.
But this is an absolute necessity! "
As he spoke, he magically took out a small bottle containing amber liquid from behind, with a capacity of about 300 ml.
"High-purity energy nutrition drink, absolutely zero side effects, two bottles for one gold coin.
It is best to use it with a meal, as it can quickly replenish various trace elements and energy lost by the body after high-intensity training. "
"I'm not trying to scare you, but your body won't be able to handle the intensity of your training just on the ordinary food in the cafeteria."
Li Qiang looked at Su Xing eagerly, his eyes looked like a personal trainer selling health care products.
Su Xing took a deep breath, looked at him speechlessly, and couldn't help but complain: "Minister Li, this drink of yours...is it high-tech?"
"Technology!
Of course technology! "
Li Qiang slapped his chest loudly, "One hundred percent hard-core technology and hard work, the pure essence of technology, the effect is amazing!"
"No, no, no,"
Su Xing waved his hands repeatedly, "I'm allergic to technology and I'm afraid I'll get a rash after drinking it."
"..."
Li Qiang was speechless for a moment, and the expression on his face was very exciting.
In the end, Su Xing paid for a dozen (12 bottles) of so-called "high-purity energy and nutrition drinks"
After all, Li Qiang was right about what he said. The subsequent training would definitely consume a lot of money, so there was no harm in trying it out.
Su Xing also knew that Li Qiang had at least increased his price by 30%, but forget it, he had a bright future, so why should he care about this?
Su Xing finally got rid of Vice Minister Li who was still unfinished and wanted to continue selling other products.
He quickly walked into an empty single training room and closed the door tightly.
The interior of the training room is simply furnished, but the space is extremely spacious. It is about twelve meters long and eight meters wide, making it look very empty.
There are no windows in the room and it is extremely quiet. Only by listening carefully can you vaguely hear the faint hum of the ventilation fan above your head.
